about: Receipts on a document open in its editor (C3b). An editor that lists the capability `changes` answers the bridge's `version` and `changes {since}` from its replica, as a headless kit answers Kit Process Protocol's `model.version` and `model.changes`. `packages/kit-editor/src/engine/kitEngine.changes.test.ts` makes `edit` on a replica of the KDM test schema holding the page `page` titled `One`, and checks that the editor answers `changes`; `crates/kition-kits/tests/live_editor.rs` answers `changes` and the diagnostics `checks` (before, after) from a fake editor window and checks the receipt of `<prefix>_run` and `<prefix>_batch`.
